scope: One fresh Google login, compared with the three-run OFF/early-dial median from 2026-10-30.
method: Open a new window in the existing Solus Benchmark profile.
Sign out to /sign-in; confirm Web Inspector Console prompt focus; clear localStorage and sessionStorage. Verify both key lists are empty.
Use the existing benchmark Google account. Keep Web Inspector open.
After workspace rendering, confirm Console prompt focus and read Navigation Timing, Resource Timing, Paint Timing, and performance marks.
limits: This is one observation against an earlier three-run median, not a controlled same-build comparison. Network and machine load can differ.
A new window and cleared application storage were used, not a newly created Safari profile. The existing profile cache and Google session were retained.
FCP is the first contentful paint, not a measure of composer interactivity. Only workspace-code and host-ready marks were available.
The current build uses /api/web/tokens. No /oauth2/token resources were recorded; its duration is not presented as the old code-exchange timing.
